llm_response.reason: The website shows multiple markers of a scam: it claims major branded collaborations (Celio, anime franchises) without providing verified business info, it offers promotional/free deals and ambiguous guarantees, there is no direct contact, privacy, or payment info accessible from the main page, and the sole hyperlink leads only to the cart. These match known patterns of fake online shopping scam sites that impersonate legitimate brands to lure customers.
